name: office-assistant
description: A chat assistant that can read and write text files and read the public web, but cannot run code or shell commands and has no accounts or credentials.

tools.read: read text files (markdown, plain text, CSV, JSON) in the working directory
tools.write: create and overwrite text files (markdown, plain text, CSV, JSON, HTML)
tools.web_fetch: fetch public web pages and unauthenticated public APIs
tools.ask_user: ask the user a question and read the answer in the conversation

lacks: running code, scripts or shell commands of any kind, and installing software
producing or editing binary files (xlsx, docx, pptx, pdf, images, audio, video)
a browser that can click, fill forms or take screenshots
accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for any external service; email, calendar, CRM or messaging integrations
publishing, deploying or writing to any external service
connectors or integrations other than the tools listed
